description: Source code implementing geohash encoding, decoding, and neighbor calculations, including bit interleaving functions and geographic range handling.

methods.name: interleave64
methods.description: Interleaves bits of two 32-bit integers into a 64-bit integer for geohash encoding.

methods.name: deinterleave64
methods.description: Reverses interleaving to extract original 32-bit components from a 64-bit interleaved value.

methods.name: geohashGetCoordRange
methods.description: Provides the valid coordinate ranges for longitude and latitude.

methods.name: geohashEncode
methods.description: Encodes geographic coordinates into a geohash bit representation based on specified ranges and step.

methods.name: geohashDecode
methods.description: Decodes a geohash into geographic coordinate ranges.

methods.name: geohashNeighbors
methods.description: Calculates neighboring geohashes in all eight directions.
